vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: The public BETTER_AUTH_SECRET fallback flows through config.auth.secret into betterAuth({ secret }) with JWT sessions. When the environment value is absent, or empty after 69fc82f7d0ef3b6816f8d3ebb97f3fa5b20be0d9 filters empty strings, the source-visible constant becomes the signing key. CVE-2026-78062 is still PUBLISHED and identifies versions 0.8.0, 0.8.1, and 0.8.2 as affected.

atomic_bic.evidence: git -S history and the commit diff identify d8711b714285b545b4010faa6e7878eb7d16ff8b as the smallest surviving public commit that first added both process.env.BETTER_AUTH_SECRET || "please-set-secret" in lib/config.ts and secret: config.auth.secret in lib/auth.ts. bd6cd2c25c0420cf9f9cd679a98563bef735f5c1 only refactored the already-present mechanism into a Zod default.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: Direct reads of parent 144e67dfa509a488766a1db4a414080d6fd05e0f show no config.auth.secret, no BETTER_AUTH_SECRET fallback, and no betterAuth secret option.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: d8711b714285b545b4010faa6e7878eb7d16ff8b is a one-parent public commit whose source and sink additions are in the same diff; its commit object contains no member list or squash metadata from which a finer public introducer can be reconstructed, so decomposition is not applicable.

affected_release_membership.evidence: The BIC is an ancestor of v0.8.0, v0.8.1, and v0.8.2, and each tag's lib/config.ts contains .default("please-set-your-key-here"). This matches the CVE.org affected-version records.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: No fixed release exists in the reviewed repository state. v0.8.5 also descends from the BIC and still contains the same default, while upstream refs/heads/main resolves to 6cb7254b854b1f69c9e13775481e6aac79972424 and retains it.

direct_fix_or_unpatched_state.evidence: The clone HEAD and independently queried upstream main are the same commit, 6cb7254b854b1f69c9e13775481e6aac79972424. HEAD still passes config.auth.secret to betterAuth and still defaults BETTER_AUTH_SECRET to the public constant; the documented secret-file generation is not implemented, so fix_sha and direct_fix_sha correctly remain null.

It contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, Made-with, bot identity, or other AI marker. findings: The primary record correctly identifies the vulnerability's source-to-sink mechanism and does not mistake the later Zod refactor for the introducer.
The introducer, immediate parent, affected tags, current upstream tip, and absence of a direct fix independently reproduce the primary causal chain.
No primary field requires correction; NOT_AI is supported by BIC-only commit metadata and message inspection.
